title: Scroll Timelines, Weighted Bento, Magnet Type, Spring Buttons & Liquid Nav
description: Five live drops: a native scroll-driven timeline, a weight-based bento reflow, cursor-field variable-font type, spring-physics magnetic buttons, and a liquid-meniscus nav bar.

drops.title: Scroll Branch Timeline
drops.description: A milestone timeline that reveals and draws its own connector line using native CSS scroll-driven animations, no scroll listener required.
drops.concept: Each timeline card uses animation-timeline: view() with a tunable animation-range so it fades, unblurs and scales in as it enters the viewport. A second scroll(nearest) timeline scales the connecting line's height from 0 to 1 across the whole section. Browsers without support fall back to an IntersectionObserver-driven equivalent so the effect never disappears.

interaction.mouse: scroll the page to trigger each card's reveal
interaction.click: debug panel sliders retune the reveal window, scale and blur live
interaction.touch: scroll works identically on touch devices

drops.title: Weighted Bento
drops.description: A bento dashboard grid that sizes tiles by a numeric weight, then FLIP-animates every tile to its new rect when weights change.
drops.concept: A tiny placement engine converts each tile's relative weight into column/row spans, then hands the rest to native CSS Grid with grid-auto-flow: dense to fill the gaps. Reshuffling or dragging a weight slider recomputes spans and animates the reflow with a FLIP transition instead of a jarring layout jump.

interaction.mouse: drag the three weight sliders or click Reshuffle/preset buttons
interaction.click: buttons randomize or set preset weight distributions

drops.title: Magnet Type
drops.description: Letters and words interpolate their variable-font weight and scale based on live distance to the cursor, with attract and repel modes.
drops.concept: On every animation frame the distance from the pointer to each character or word's center is measured. Units within a tunable radius interpolate font-variation-settings weight and a scale transform between rest and peak values, using a linear or quadratic falloff curve for a tighter or looser hot zone. A repel mode pushes text away from the cursor instead of bulking it up.

interaction.mouse: hover near any headline, paragraph or line to see it react
interaction.click: debug panel toggles attract/repel and linear/quadratic falloff
interaction.touch: drag a finger across the text on touch devices

drops.title: Spring Magnetic Buttons
drops.description: Buttons pulled toward the cursor by a real spring-physics integrator, with tunable stiffness, damping and mass.
drops.concept: Instead of a CSS transition easing curve, each button runs its own Hooke's-law spring simulation stepped every animation frame: force = -stiffness * displacement - damping * velocity. Three presets (Snappy, Bouncy, Smooth) show how the same mechanism feels completely different at different stiffness/damping ratios, and a fourth button exposes live sliders plus the resulting damping ratio.
drops.source: Spring-physics parameter model (stiffness/damping/mass) popularized by the Kinetics motion library

interaction.mouse: move near any button to feel the magnetic pull, click for a ripple
interaction.click: ripples on click; debug sliders retune the fourth button's spring
interaction.touch: touch-drag near a button pulls it the same way

drops.title: Meniscus Liquid Nav
drops.description: A bottom navigation bar whose top edge behaves like a liquid surface, dipping into a bead around the active tab.
drops.concept: The entire bar outline is one SVG path. The socket around the active tab is built from tangent-style bezier shoulders and a bowl whose left/right radii skew asymmetrically based on the bead's live velocity, so the dip leans in the direction of travel. The bead itself squashes and stretches along its motion, volume-preserving, driven by a spring-physics target position updated on tab tap or arrow keys.

interaction.mouse: click a tab to see the bead spring toward it
interaction.click: tapping a tab moves the bead and updates the screen title
interaction.touch: tabs are large touch targets; works identically on mobile
